storage.readError: The saved data could not be loaded. Automatic saving is blocked for this section. Your original data is preserved.
storage.writeError: Your changes have not been saved yet. Local storage is full or unavailable. Try again or export the data to a file before closing the app.
storage.changedError: The saved data has changed elsewhere. Please reload it. Unsaved changes in this section will be discarded when you do.
storage.pendingReadError: Your changes have not been saved because storage could not be read. Please try again. Your changes remain in this open app until then.
storage.recoveryError: Recovery could not be saved safely. Check the available storage and try again. Your original data was not replaced.
storage.obsidianBlocked: Please recover your saved data before connecting, syncing or disconnecting Obsidian.
storage.learningBlocked: Please resolve the storage errors above first. Controls and study timers are paused; your current inputs remain in this open app.
storage.blocked: This section is temporarily locked. Continue editing after recovery.
storage.pendingWarning: Your unsaved changes are still present in this session. Export them before reloading, restoring or resetting.
storage.confirmReset: Reset “{title}” to its defaults? The original data will be archived separately first.
storage.exported: {data} exported. This file is for repair and is not an importable flashcard collection.
